subject.title: Feature request: Read pinned Telegram messages via bot API

question: Should OpenClaw expose Telegram pinned-message reads, and should the first version be an explicit on-demand action/command or automatic session context?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested behavior exposes persistent chat content to agents and needs maintainer intent on defaults, authorization, and whether pinned context should be fetched only on demand.

options.title: On-demand gated action first
options.body: Add a Telegram-owned list-pins/read-pinned action or native command backed by getChat.pinned_message and controlled by an explicit action/config gate.

options.title: Fold into broader Telegram read work
options.body: Track pinned-message reads under the broader Telegram message-read design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/12756 and decide one retained-message/read contract first.

options.title: Defer automatic context
options.body: Keep automatic session-start pinned context out of core until maintainers approve storage, injection, and security-default behavior.

recommendation.title: On-demand gated action first
recommendation.body: Add a Telegram-owned list-pins/read-pinned action or native command backed by getChat.pinned_message and controlled by an explicit action/config gate.

likelyOwner.reason: He already supplied the prior detailed review and is the clearest visible routing candidate for the product/security decision on this issue.
